name: english_child_calibrated
description: English child phonology calibrated from PhonBank Davis+Providence (3.18M aligned phones)
source: Calibrated from PhonBank (TalkBank) CC BY-NC-SA. Process weights are measured facts, not creative content — publishable per the plan §2c licensing strategy. See calibrate_phonbank.py for methodology.

notes.caveat: These are PER-PHONE rates from alignment data; the corruptor uses PER-WORD rates. The conversion assumes ~4 phones/word (see calibrate_phonbank.py). The high insertion rate (42.9%) was excluded — likely alignment convention artifacts.
